description.value: The 10-item Revised Restraint Scale was administered to identify chronic dieting and weight concerns and to classify twin pairs as restrained or unrestrained eaters. Restrained eaters scored at least 15 and at least 3 points above their co-twin; unrestrained eaters scored below 15.

spans.text: We defined restrained eaters as those with a score of 15 or more and that was 3 or more points higher than their co-twins' score. Unrestrained eaters scored less than 15.
